operating_scope: observed Current > 100 A and Power > 5 kW; 120 s continuous historical context; gaps >2 s reset context
rul_basis: remaining powered hours, not wall-clock hours
pressure_now_conversion: mbar / 1000 = bar; preserve physical hopper identity

tasks.predicted_anomaly_eta_s: TCN conditional estimate only; unavailable for primary tree/logistic risk
tasks.next_anomaly_type: TCN conditional multi-label estimate; not paired with a separate tree/logistic probability
tasks.current_anomaly: last_completed_product_proxy_head; online instantaneous detection not validated

compatibility: Requires adapter and null/status-aware dashboard; not compatible with legacy 21-parameter checkpoint loader
